traffic.clear_junction.tooltip: Takes the right-of-way rules off every arm of the junction, as one undo step.
traffic.this_piece.tooltip: A speed limit or overtaking ban goes on the road piece you point at.
traffic.whole_road.tooltip: A speed limit or overtaking ban goes on every piece of the road you point at, from junction to junction or to a free end.
traffic.custom.tooltip: A speed in km/h for the Custom speed tile. Enter arms the tile.
traffic.tab.rules.tooltip: Signs for the arms of a junction (priority road, yield) and the overtaking ban for road pieces.
traffic.tab.speed.tooltip: Speed limits for the pieces of a road.
traffic.sign.priority_road.tooltip: StVO 306. The arm's paths straight on and to the right go first (priority 192).
traffic.sign.yield.tooltip: StVO 205. Every path of the arm lets the others go first (priority 64).
traffic.sign.normal.tooltip: No rule: the arm's paths keep the default priority. Takes a sign off an arm.
traffic.sign.custom.tooltip: The speed typed in the Speed row of the options.
traffic.sign.speed.tooltip: Speed limit {kmh} km/h (StVO 274) on every lane for vehicles of a road piece.
traffic.sign.overtaking.tooltip: StVO 276. No overtaking on the lanes for vehicles of a road piece.
traffic.sign.clear_road.tooltip: Takes the speed limit off a road piece. Its overtaking ban and other traffic rules stay.
traffic.sign.clear_overtaking.tooltip: Takes the overtaking ban off a road piece. Its speed limit and other traffic rules stay.

traffic.status.start: Traffic rules: priority and speed signs.

traffic.status.none_here: Traffic rules: no junction here; click a junction object to see the signs of its arms.

traffic.status.no_road: Traffic rules: no road here; speeds go onto roads.
traffic.status.no_lanes: Traffic rules: this piece has no lane for vehicles; speeds go only onto roads.
traffic.status.custom_invalid: Traffic rules: type a speed between 1 and 250 km/h in the Speed row first.
traffic.status.pick_sign: Traffic rules: pick a sign first, then click a road.

traffic.status.dropped_outside: The sign was let go outside the map; nothing changed.
traffic.status.drop_on_arm: Drop the sign on the sign of one of the arms.
